name: Ocean
description: Ocean word search puzzles with a slow, tidal feel. These free online grids collect shoreline and deep-water words — tides, harbors, reefs and seabirds — written for adults who want a relaxing puzzle rather than flashy games. Pick an easy grid, a medium puzzle with diagonals, or a hard one with reverse words. Play in your browser, enable large print if you prefer, and take your time. No sign-up required.
